assertions.title: learn git is idempotent (no duplicate rows)

steps.action: Learn the same repo twice with --project --json --no-tui
steps.expected: Second learn should replace source data without growing document/chunk counts
steps.observed: Both runs indexed 1 document / 1 chunk; db scope stayed at documents=1 and chunks=1

assertions.title: learn git tolerates single-file read failure

steps.action: Learn a repo with one readable tracked file and one missing tracked file
steps.expected: Command exits 0 when at least one document is indexed and reports structured file failures
steps.observed: Exit code 0, documentsIndexed=1, and fileFailures[0] reported stat/ENOENT for missing.md

assertions.title: learn git external git processes have timeouts

steps.action: Inject a PATH-first fake git that execs sleep and run learn git
steps.expected: CLI terminates the hanging git subprocess after the configured wall-clock timeout
steps.observed: Process exited in ~30.3s with GitProcessTimeoutError / code GIT_PROCESS_TIMEOUT

steps.action: Check the fake git PID after the CLI returns
steps.observed: Recorded fake git PID was no longer alive

assertions.title: re-learn removes deleted files

steps.action: Learn a repo containing a deletable marker file, then delete and commit it
steps.expected: Second learn should remove the deleted file from retrievable content
steps.observed: Second learn dropped documentsIndexed from 2 to 1

steps.action: Search the deleted marker and run get deleted.md
steps.expected: Search returns 0 hits and get fails because the file is gone
steps.observed: get deleted.md failed as expected, but search gone999marker still returned keep.md

assertions.issues: Search still returned the surviving tracked file for the deleted marker query instead of zero hits.

assertions.title: learn git indexes tracked files only

steps.action: Learn a repo with one tracked marker file and one untracked marker file
steps.expected: Tracked marker is searchable and untracked marker is not indexed
steps.observed: Tracked marker was searchable, but querying the untracked marker still returned the tracked file

assertions.issues: The untracked-marker search returned the tracked document instead of zero hits.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 3 passed (001, 002, 003) and 2 failed (004, 005). Also ran `bun run smoke:google`, which passed.
